semantics.clock: Update state on rising clk edge; diagram gives transitions for sampled in.
semantics.reset: Original text: asynchronously reset into state B if reset is high. areset is active high, overrides transitions while high.
semantics.output: Moore output depends only on current state, without added latency.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; no initializer; verification begins functional state checks after reset.

numeric.port_widths: All ports one bit as specified
numeric.state_encoding: A=0, B=1; no arithmetic or counters

verification.oracle: Explicit original A/B transition table maintained independently in testbench
cases: reset priority at rising clock edge
input changes between edges do not change output
falling clock edges do not change state
reset release holds state until rising edge
verification.sampling: Check after a delay following edges to allow nonblocking state update
verification.completion: Fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, PASS only at completion

specification_ambiguities.item: Active clock edge is not explicitly stated in the prose or diagram
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use rising edge of clk, the conventional clock interpretation for this synchronous FSM.

specification_ambiguities.item: State before first reset or clock is unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not impose a defined power-up state or assert a pre-reset value.
